approvedAuthority.sliceTitle: Configurable local sign-in and application security settings

outcome: The desktop now has one native, versioned application-wide sign-in policy with exactly no login, Windows password, and Windows Hello. Absent state becomes explicit no login; valid predecessor password state preserves profile and timeout semantics; invalid protected state fails locked. Protected transitions are native-authorized, verified, confirmed, compare-and-swap published, and single-instance across one canonical application root. The separate Application Settings destination presents the authoritative policy and provider availability, preserves the open project and guided-workflow position, keeps locked recovery secret-free and modal, and reports cancellations, failures, response-loss reconciliation, and concurrent policy conflicts truthfully without silent downgrade.

integrationChecks.result: All 57 executed native library tests passed and the renderer witness was intentionally ignored for its dedicated harness. The union covers exact absent/predecessor migration, three-mode parsing, invalid-state lockout, provider ordering, same-SID recovery, transition confirmation, byte-stable adverse outcomes, response-loss receipts, compare-and-swap publication, single-instance process authority, abrupt termination, abandoned mutex recovery, restart/manual/idle behavior, Hello outcome mapping, lock generations, Core-start recovery, and redacted audit.

All 37 focused renderer/runtime/settings/workspace tests passed. The real Rust witness and all three production TypeScript bridge tests also passed, proving strict closed decoding, native-success-only unlock authority, exact policy receipts, complete source/target reconciliation, truthful different-policy conflict handling, draft separation, focus restoration, and preserved workflow state.

Eighteen security/source/portable-contract/Windows credential tests passed; one redirected-vault symlink case was skipped because directory symlinks are unavailable to the current Windows token. The passing union covers native lock-generation authority, same-SID non-persisting password proof, HWND-bound Hello with no PIN or biometric capture, exact sign-in policy modes/default, secret-safe user-scoped storage, compare-and-swap behavior, redaction, corruption, and recoverable ciphertext.

The exact UI gate confirms one approved-reference implementation bound to RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.4 and its exact eight governed UI paths.

All 14 workflow profiles, 139 browser cases, 390 keyboard cases, and 66 accessibility/responsive cases passed. R03 changed no approved reference, CSS, tokens, route, visual baseline, package, or layout primitive, so the independently authenticated 66-capture R02 visual replay remains reusable.
The real Windows x64 OS boundary returned exactly {schemaVersion:'1.0', provider:'windows-hello', availability:'not-present'}. No configured interactive success is inferred or fabricated.

adversarialBoundary.configurationAuthority: Only the native manager can verify providers, issue an opaque prepared transition, validate confirmation and expiry, compare source authority, and atomically publish a successor policy. Renderer/session possession and confirmation text provide no proof.
adversarialBoundary.processAuthority: One release-authoritative desktop process may own a canonical application-data root. Duplicate startup is denied before manager/Core construction; abrupt termination releases the existence lease; restart reads the durable policy and a protected mode starts locked.
adversarialBoundary.downgradeBoundary: Cancellation, denial, unavailable destination, busy, failure, expiry, stale writer, write failure, response loss, corruption, or unknown version cannot silently publish none or another requested policy. A different observed policy is displayed as authoritative conflict, not success or unchanged.
adversarialBoundary.secretBoundary: Hello receives only the desktop HWND and fixed prompt through the OS-owned verifier; password recovery retains non-persisting current-process EqualSid proof. Locked and recovery views disclose no project or research content and the app receives no PIN or biometric.
adversarialBoundary.experienceBoundary: Application Settings is separate from Project Settings. The live guided-workflow instance remains mounted but inaccessible during the detour, return focus follows the initiating control, locked confirmation makes the background inert, and visible and assistive status use the same truthful result.
